description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the SOUL五律 framework and its exact file naming conventions, mandatory annotation syntax, and red-line rules.
2. Agent creates `design_log/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (date-named file) containing a full 四向碰撞 analysis with all four Chinese section headers (正面/反面/侧面/整体). Each design claim must be annotated with either `[已知依据]` (backed by existing research/specs) or `[UNKNOWN-需用户测试]` (requiring future validation). WCAG 2.1 AA must be explicitly cited in the accessibility section. The 反面 section must address failure scenarios including color-blind users and/or small screens. The 侧面 section must address component reusability and design system impact.
3. Agent updates the existing `design_decisions.md` (which currently contains only a broken stub) to add a proper decision entry for the button color change, referencing #1A73E8, and marking the decision as 不可逆 (irreversible) because it is a system-wide token change — as required by the skill's rule that irreversible decisions must always be recorded.
4. Agent creates a new file in `iteration_history/` documenting the v2 button spec (referencing the new color and rationale).
5. All four of these artifacts must be present and correctly structured for the audit committee documentation package to be considered complete.
